issues.problem: In the game screen the player square ends touching the flag, so the two are hard to tell apart in the final frame.
issues.suggested_fix: Stop the player a little left of the flag or move the flag further right.

issues.problem: The "Trip wire" label sits in the right-hand column, far from the red line in the doorway it names.
issues.suggested_fix: Attach the label to the wire with a Callout, or place it next to the bell.

issues.problem: The frozen robot is grey but its white eye is still open, which weakens the "stopped" reading.
issues.suggested_fix: Grey out or shut the eye as well when the bell rings.
